Method of Attack: Remote command injection via failure to sanitize processing of user-supplied .tar file names in Barracuda Email Security Gateway appliance
Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in email attachment scanning module allowing remote execution of system commands through Perl's qx operator with product privileges
Impacted Systems: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (appliance form factor only)
Attack Vector: Maliciously crafted .tar file attachment processed by the email attachment scanning module
Indicators of Compromise: Notification via ESG user interface to impacted customers
